problem.heading: The problems facing agriculture
problem.subcopy: Gaps in information and technology between producers, distributors and consumers keep rural Latin America poor.

items.title: Technology
items.body: rural inhabitants in the region lack meaningful connectivity: with no signal or data, precision agriculture never reaches the farm.

items.title: Information
items.body: of farms in the region are family farms, and there is still no systematic data to measure their productivity.

items.title: Financing
items.body: of smallholder credit demand goes unmet: a US$170 billion gap.

solutions.subcopy: Eight integrated solutions on one data foundation, so every player decides with the same data: complete, standardized, verified and processed.

ifis.heading: We are part of the whole credit analysis process
ifis.subcopy: From prospecting to collections, the same data supports every stage of the decision.

stages.name: Prospecting
stages.lead: Sector analysis by crop and producer prospecting.
stages.body: Where the universe is, what it grows and on how much land.

stages.name: Origination
stages.body: Amount, term and collateral set by the plot's risk band.

stages.name: Monitoring
stages.lead: Satellite monitoring and alerts on pledged plots.
stages.body: Stress, drought or waterlogging crossed with the repayment calendar.

stages.name: Collections
stages.body: Reschedule before the due date, not after default.

ifis.callout: We don't only come in at the end.
ifis.calloutBody: The same measurement that approves the loan monitors it during the cycle and anticipates collections: one productive source of repayment, auditable from start to finish.

actors.heading: The same data solves every player's pain point
actors.subcopy: Every digitized plot feeds the score, origination and territorial intelligence. Pick a player to see their pain point and what InteliCrop delivers.

items.name: Producers and associations
items.pain: They farm without data on their own plot and with little access to credit.
items.deliver: An app with pest, water-stress and weather alerts, plus a productive track record that opens the door to credit and insurance.

items.name: Banks and credit unions
items.pain: They lend to agriculture without seeing the crop behind the loan: default arrives before the information does.
items.deliver: Agroclimatic Score per plot, monitoring of pledged plots and real-time alerts throughout the cycle.

items.name: Insurers
items.pain: They underwrite and adjust policies without objective evidence of each plot's physical risk.
items.deliver: Climate risk by agroclimatic zone, ENSO scenarios and remote verification of crop condition.

items.name: Agribusiness and exporters
items.pain: They don't know what, where or how much will be harvested, nor can they prove where it comes from.
items.deliver: Yield forecasts, polygon-level traceability and compliance with the EU deforestation regulation.

items.name: Agricultural inputs
items.pain: They sell without knowing where real demand is or how their products perform in the field.
items.deliver: Maps of active area by crop and readings of health, nitrogen and stress to recommend the right application.

items.name: Government and multilaterals
items.pain: They design policies, insurance and programs without territorial evidence.
items.deliver: Territorial intelligence by country, province and canton: area, health, yield and climate risk.

sustainability.heading: Bigger harvests, smaller footprint
sustainability.subcopy: We make key sustainable practices available to agriculture and track their progress with the same satellite data.
practices: Water footprint reduction and irrigation advice
sustainability.odsBody: At InteliCrop we are committed to sustainability and to advancing the Sustainable Development Goals.
sustainability.eudr: Traceability and deforestation-free evidence for exporters' EUDR compliance.

about.heading: A data-driven agri-fintech
about.body: InteliCrop is an agricultural analytics and technology company. We combine satellite imagery (200+ satellites, 3×3 m resolution and over 40 years of history), climate data and field data with AI models trained for more than 170 crops, 100% in the cloud.
about.body2: We put that intelligence to work for those who finance, buy, insure and regulate agriculture: financial institutions, agribusiness and exporters, governments, certifiers, associations and producers themselves.
about.cropin: Official CROPIN representative in Ecuador and LATAM

statements.name: Purpose
statements.body: Close the information gap between the field and capital so every producer is visible, measurable and financeable.

statements.name: Mission
statements.body: Drive farmers' development through a smart agricultural cloud that turns satellite, climate and field data into production, credit and sustainability decisions.

statements.name: Vision 2030
statements.body: Be Latin America's reference platform for measuring agricultural productive risk and enabling responsible financing for more than one million hectares.
